entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet and... it's just all a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you look into that. To start, could you tell me your order number?
Oh, sure. It's... VF88-10294. I'm just not sure what to do.
Thank you, I have your order pulled up now. I see the Pro-Frame helmet. Before we go further, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

A preference, I guess? My daughter said the color wasn't what she wanted. It's not the right shade of green. The box is still unopened, we never even took it out. I'm just so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm happy to help. It's no problem at all. Getting the right color is important, especially for safety gear you'll be wearing all the time. Let me just check the delivery date here.
Okay... I hope it's not too late.
Not at all. I see it was delivered 56 days ago. Our policy for a standard item like this helmet allows for returns within 90 days. You are well within that window.
Oh, really? That's wonderful! I was so worried I had missed the deadline. Thank you!

You're very welcome. And since you mentioned the box is unopened, that makes it even easier. I'm processing the return now and I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email on file. Do you have access to that?
Yes, I do! Thank you so much, Alex. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
